[IDSP.7.4] The read path has **no callback** — the engine
answers `cache-get` from its own map. `cache-set` /
`cache-delete` first mutate the engine's cache, then route
to **two optional write-through persistence callbacks**
registered as a bundle with one shared user pointer:

The setter keeps the name `ds_engine_cache_callbacks` (no
`set_` prefix): the two persistence ops are one durability
surface. `runtime/include/libds.h` gives its signature.
